Hey there! Hope you're doing well. I've been having so much fun with this new hobby I picked up, and I thought you'd like to hear about it. It's all about calligraphy! I've been practicing different styles and techniques, and it's been super relaxing.

I started by getting a few basic supplies - a nice fountain pen, some high-quality ink, and a few different nibs. Then I began practicing on practice sheets to get the hang of the different styles. It's amazing how different the same letter can look depending on the angle and pressure you use.

The best part is the way it feels to write. It's such a meditative process
